title: A-share Industry Network Contract v2
description: A temporal company, listing and production-evidence network. Product mappings remain review candidates and anonymous counterparties remain aggregate concentrations rather than company edges.

announcement_time.description: Official filing date or timestamp retained as source metadata.

available_time.description: Earliest verified local model availability; all snapshots filter on this field.

effective_time.description: When a lifecycle event changes network state.

listings.csv.description: Security listing spells linked to enterprises.

company_relations.csv.description: Evidence-backed supplier, customer, competitor and substitution edges between identified companies. Period transaction observations must not be continued beyond valid_to.

named_counterparty_relation_evidence.csv.description: Optional sidecar governed by named_counterparty_relation_evidence_v1; preserves quotes, page numbers, identity evidence and separate availability times.

named_relation_corroborations.csv.description: Optional sidecar governed by named_relation_corroboration_v1; corroborates identity or group linkage without upgrading transaction facts.

products.csv.description: Controlled product and service vocabulary; a node alone makes no company-activity claim.

activity_product_candidates.csv.description: Verbatim-evidence mappings awaiting explicit human review.

counterparty_concentrations.csv.description: Aggregate customer or supplier exposure when counterparties cannot be identified.

lifecycle_events.csv.description: Listing, suspension, risk-warning, delisting and relisting events.
